clause_reviews.dataset_passage: First Semester Students:** Scholarship is determined by the marks/rank obtained in the PET (Pre-Engineering Test) examination conducted by the Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board.    - **For Polytechnic First Semester Students:** Scholarship is determined by the percentage of total marks obtained in the qualifying examination for admission.    - **For Diploma Holders Admitted to B.E. through Lateral Entry:** Merit is determined by the percentage of marks obtained in the final year of the diploma.    - **For Students in Higher Classes:** Scholarship is granted based on the merit list prepared from the marks of the previous passed semester examination.    - **Post-Selection Conditions:** The scholarship is subject to satisfactory academic progress and regular attendance of the student
